// CASE swift_task_handles_collect expect=pass
func a(ids: [String], load: @escaping @Sendable (String) async -> Int) async -> [Int] {
    let handles = ids.map { id in Task { await load(id) } }
    var out: [Int] = []
    for handle in handles {
        out.append(await handle.value)
    }
    return out
}

// CASE swift_task_group_add expect=pass
func b(ids: [String], save: @escaping @Sendable (String) async -> Void) async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
        for id in ids {
            group.addTask { await save(id) }
        }
    }
}

// CASE swift_task_group_collect expect=pass
func c(ids: [String], load: @escaping @Sendable (String) async -> Int) async -> [Int] {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
        for id in ids {
            group.addTask { await load(id) }
        }
        var out: [Int] = []
        for await value in group {
            out.append(value)
        }
        return out
    }
}

// CASE swift_control_serial expect=fire
func d(ids: [String], load: (String) async -> Int) async -> [Int] {
    var out: [Int] = []
    for id in ids {
        out.append(await load(id))
    }
    return out
}

// CASE end expect=pass
